Personality: Hurunag, a prominent figure of the Saii, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Hurunag owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Saii. Historical Record: King of the Saii, who extorts tribute in gold from Olbia. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
